newsitem.title: USA: Electroglas says may incur Q4 oper loss.
newsitem.headline: Electroglas says may incur Q4 oper loss.

text.p: Electroglas Inc, a maker of semiconductor wafer probing systems, said on Tuesday it may incur an operating loss in the fourth quarter on revenues between $19 and $20 million.
Electroglas said it could not quantify the exact operating loss, but financial results will be below analysts' estimates.

It cited slower than anticipated "turns", or orders, for the shortfall. "The reduced backlog we had entering the current quarter, combined with the weak bookings rate early in the quarter, have caused estimated shipment levels to fall," Curt Wozniak, chief executive officer, said.
Analysts had expected the company to earn a profit of $0.04 a share in the quarter, according to First Call.
In the year ago quarter, Electroglas reported a profit of $0.64 a share.
"The dramatic reduction in capital spending by the semiconductor industry has continued to impact our revenue," Wozniak said.
Electroglas shares ended trading on Tuesday off 5/8 at 16-5/8.
Though the fourth quarter has proved difficult for the company, Electroglas said more recent bookings have shown positive trends, especially in the number of competitive bids on its new 4090 product.
